specialties.name: Poison Master

specialties.description: +3 Poison Resist. Reduces direct and status damage; status values and decay are unchanged.

specialties.name: Assassin
specialties.intent: You spend the first half of a battle not existing, and the whole of it is arranged so that one enemy has an ally in front of it and you behind.

triggers.effect: you begin the Battle in stealth: you cannot be seen and cannot be targeted by an attack. Area effects, terrain and auras all still reach you. It breaks the moment you use an attack or a power, and whenever a reveal effect finds you — moving never breaks it

specialties.name: Shadowdancer
specialties.intent: You are never where the swing lands, because you were never on that hex; the map has a hole in it and the hole is you.

powers.description: Take 4 true damage to raise the ward properly: Protection equal to 3 + twice your Resist, and remove 5 Burn from yourself. Decline the damage and the ward is only Protection equal to your Resist. The barrier is paid for in the currency it protects.
powers.source: Hell-TCG name reused (Demon Hunter/Demonic Ward, Soul Barrier — scaled off Resist rather than Ranged, since Precision is damage-only now) | 2026-08-17: Protection has no duration — it decays 1 a Turn and by the damage it absorbs. Duration clause removed. | 2026-08-17: "difficult terrain" is not a thing in HoBaT — there are hexes that cost extra Movement. Reworded. | 2026-08-17 quality pass: a flat Protection grant with no decision. Now a cost/benefit — the full ward is bought with 4 true damage.

powers.name: Spectral Sight
powers.description: Reveal every unit in stealth within your Vision and break its stealth. For the rest of the Battle, darkness and fog do not reduce your Vision.
powers.source: Hell-TCG name reused (Demon Hunter/Demonic Ward, Spectral Sight — the +2 Reach was cut; this is the class's own answer to the class's stealth line, and the reason the enemy roster can carry stealth at all) | 2026-08-17: "difficult terrain" is not a thing in HoBaT — there are hexes that cost extra Movement. Reworded. | 2026-08-20: "everything you can see" as a target shape is cut — the power reads your own Vision, which is a stat, not a targeting shape.

powers.name: Consume Magic
powers.description: remove 5 Burn and Poison from the target and heal it 4.
powers.source: Hell-TCG name reused (Demon Hunter/Demonic Ward, Consume Magic — extended to reach an ally, which is the whole reason this specialty is in a party) | 2026-08-17: "difficult terrain" is not a thing in HoBaT — there are hexes that cost extra Movement. Reworded. | 2026-08-20: "if the target was carrying at least 4 of either, heal 4 instead" is a threshold branch on the target's status count. Flat 4.

powers.name: Warded Ground
powers.description: Aura 2, centred on you, for the rest of the Battle: every enemy inside gains 2 Burn at the end of your Activation.
powers.source: new (the defensive anchor the Demon Hunter line needed, built on the two creature tags the class is named for) | 2026-08-17: "difficult terrain" is not a thing in HoBaT — there are hexes that cost extra Movement. Reworded. | 2026-08-17 quality pass: carried a condition the engine cannot check ('while you do not move on your Turn'). Rebuilt on zones of control, which is what warding ground means. | 2026-08-17: every unit has Sidestep, so a zone of control cannot pin anything — it taxes the SECOND hex of a withdrawal, not the first. Reworded to say what it actually does. | 2026-08-20: the zone-of-control clause is cut — taxing movement out of a hex is a subsystem, and this is the fourth entry carrying it. Burn instead.

triggers.effect: AURA radius 2 — every enemy inside gains 2 Burn at the end of your Activation

powers.name: Crossbow Shot
powers.description: Until the end of your next Turn, your attacks gain +5 Crit, and a further +2 Precision and +10 Accuracy against demon or undead.
powers.source: Hell-TCG name reused (Demon Hunter, Crossbow Shot — the -1 damage penalty replaced with a slayer band, so it is a choice rather than a worse attack) | 2026-08-17: was an attack in its own right, so it competed with the weapon in your hands and lost the moment you found a good one. Rebuilt as a next-attack modifier. | 2026-08-17: "difficult terrain" is not a thing in HoBaT — there are hexes that cost extra Movement. Reworded. | 2026-08-20: "your next <form> attack" is gone. Nothing tracks which attack is next or what form it is. Rewritten as a duration: until the end of your next Turn, your attacks carry it. The form qualifier is dropped with it.

powers.name: Demon Hunting
powers.description: Stance: for the rest of the Battle you have +2 Strength and +2 Precision against demon and undead and -5 Accuracy against everything else; remove 5 Burn from yourself now.
powers.source: Hell-TCG name reused (Demon Hunter class power, Demon Hunting — the unconditional stat dump rebuilt as a commitment against two creature tags) | 2026-08-17: "difficult terrain" is not a thing in HoBaT — there are hexes that cost extra Movement. Reworded.

powers.name: Repay in Kind
powers.description: Until the end of your next Turn, your attacks gain +3 Precision and +15 Accuracy.
powers.source: Hell-TCG mechanic reused, renamed (badge power Counter-Strike and Vengeance — Thorns rebuilt as an actual return shot, since HoBaT makes you roll for it) | 2026-08-17: was an attack in its own right, so it competed with the weapon in your hands and lost the moment you found a good one. Rebuilt as a next-attack modifier. | 2026-08-17: "difficult terrain" is not a thing in HoBaT — there are hexes that cost extra Movement. Reworded. | 2026-08-20: "your next <form> attack" is gone. Nothing tracks which attack is next or what form it is. Rewritten as a duration: until the end of your next Turn, your attacks carry it. The form qualifier is dropped with it. ALSO cut "usable only after you have taken damage since the start of your last Turn" — a condition reading your damage history, which nothing tracks.

powers.name: Every Wound Remembered
powers.description: Gain +5 Crit and +10 Accuracy for the rest of the Battle, and heal 4.
powers.source: new (the specialty's own trigger stacks Crit off being hit — this is the power that keeps you alive long enough to spend it) | 2026-08-17: "difficult terrain" is not a thing in HoBaT — there are hexes that cost extra Movement. Reworded. | 2026-08-20: a "usable only if" gate on your own or the target's state is not a thing — nothing reads a Health threshold or an event history to decide whether a power is legal. "heal 2 for every 10 Health you are currently missing" read a Health threshold and scaled off it. Flat numbers instead.

powers.name: Slip Away
powers.description: Immediately enter stealth: you cannot be seen and cannot be targeted by an attack. It breaks the moment you attack, and area effects, terrain and auras reach you anyway.
powers.intent: Not an escape — a question the enemy has to answer before it can do anything else.
powers.source: new 2026-08-20: wants more things touching stealth. The cheap, repeatable entry into it.
